outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Overweight and obese pregnant women were found to have a higher risk of diabetes mellitus, hypertension, macrosomia, cesarean sections, incomplete and manual removal of placenta, and blood loss >300 ml compared to women with normal BMI.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese pregnant women were found to have a higher risk of cesarean sections compared to women with normal BMI.
